title: Police investigate Abbotsford in-custody death
article: Homicide investigators in Metro Vancouver are investigating the death of a man who lost consciousness after he was arrested by Abbotsford police on Friday.
Investigators with the Integrated Homicide Investigation Team were called in to conduct an outside investigation after Christopher Leslie Kampman, 37, died in hospital on Sunday.
An earlier release from Abbotsford Police said Kampman was arrested after officers responded to a call about a prowler around 3:30 a.m. PT on Friday.
Kampman was arrested, but police said he was combative and making incoherent remarks so the officers called an ambulance.
But while Kampman was waiting handcuffed in the back of a police cruiser, he abruptly lost consciousness, said Abbotsford police.
